company.shortDescription: Welltok is an enterprise SaaS company that delivers a healthcare consumer activation platform.
company.description:
Welltok is a data-driven, enterprise SaaS company that delivers the healthcare industry’s leading consumer activation platform. Welltok’s solutions empower health plans, employers, providers, and public entities to connect consumers with personalized health improvement resources, making it easy and rewarding for consumers to complete actions that optimize their health and wellbeing. 

The company was founded in 2009 and headquartered in Denver, Colorado.

productsAndServices.description: A healthcare SaaS platform that connects consumers with personalized health improvement resources to encourage health-related actions.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series E round raised $10,440,000, or 3.11% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 13 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $130,018,558 to $860,440,000, a 6.62x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 48 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 37 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
